entities.name: first palm-covered family cart (parked, no team)
entities.what: Big palm-covered family cart (大棕盖车) parked on the north side of the road in front of the official hall: a huge shaggy roof of palm fibre over a tall box body, a black cord along the roof's ridge that loops down near each end, a lattice-railed under-frame and one big spoked wheel (the near, south one) showing above the south roof. At its east end a short frame juts out and ends in a carved beam end (the roots of the shafts, read as its front); no shafts, yoke or animals are drawn, so it stands unhitched. A small figure stands at its west end and a person sits under the thatch at its front.
entities.vis: part: the wheel's lower half, the ground line and both ends' undersides hidden by the south roof; the north side hidden
entities.src: 余辉: 豪车云集 (the first of the two palm-covered carts)
entities.note: Roof (thatch skirt) u 12672-13068, from the ridge cord at v 959-967 down to its fringe at v ~1100-1110. Ridge cord from (12729, 965) to (12998, 960); it drops at the west end along u 12729-12740 (v 965-1015) and curls west round a pale rounded shape (see S4b.prop.big_jar_12707), and drops again at u 12940-12958 (v 959-1025); the roof part east of that drop (u 12958-13064) is like the front hood of the second cart (S4b's t2 cart at 13120), which faces east. Under-frame/bed v ~1105-1195 from u 12715 to the east frame's end (13023-13073, v 1150-1185). FACING (conf low-med): front = east, from (1) the hood-like roof part east of the second cord drop, as on the second cart's front, and (2) the jutting frame with a carved end at the east, read as the shafts' roots; the west end, where a front would show shafts, is hidden by the south roof below v ~1150, so a front to the west (shafts hidden under that roof) can't be excluded. No team anywhere near (bare road at u 13080-13260, v 1140-1260). The thatch-covered shade on a post at u 12969-13109, v 1197-1280 (S4b.prop.thatch_shade_13049) stands just south-east of its front. SCALE CUE: near wheel's outer rim u 12755-12907 (152 px across), top of the rim v 1128, sides at v ~1185-1195; hub hidden (est (12831, 1200)); bottom hidden behind the south roof (est v 1276, so the contact is est); body ~400 px long (u 12672-13073) and ~290 px from the ridge to the ground. Ground: near wheel contact est v 1276; the cart's centre line est v 1225 (half a ~2 m track, ~50 px, north of the near wheel), used for front and rear. DEPTH DIRECTION: none usable (drawn side-on; the east frame's end beam (13023, 1153) -> (13073, 1180), slope +0.54, is a side profile, not a receding edge). Part 1's 'not yet mapped' list names 'the palm-covered cart's roof at 12690-12920': this is it.

entities.name: small figure at the first cart's west end (child?)
entities.what: A small figure in light clothes standing at the west end of the first palm-covered cart, just under the fringe of its thatch, head turned south; only the head and shoulders show between the thatch and the south roof. Probably a child (a servant boy of the family?).
entities.vis: part: below the shoulders hidden by the south roof (its ridge at v ~1147 here)
entities.note: Head u 12698-12714, v 1108-1127; shoulders to v ~1147, where the south roof (S4.bld.south_hall_12350's neighbour roof, structures_w) cuts it. The head is ~13 px wide against ~20 px for adults nearby, so it reads as a child about 75-80 px tall standing on the cart's far (north) side, foot est v ~1195 (the far wheel line, ~1175-1200). Other reading: an adult standing at the cart's near side with feet at v ~1270 behind the roof; then the head would be small for its depth. Candidate for part 1's 'a small boy' (map/index.md, S4 inner seam). The restyle paints a small light figure here too.

entities.name: thatch-covered shade on a post south-east of the first cart
entities.what: A long fan-shaped shade of palm thatch or ribbed matting, its ribs radiating from a narrow west end and widening to a rounded east end, set on a single post with a bracket, standing just south-east of the first cart's front, above the second cart's roof.
entities.vis: part: the post's foot hidden behind the second cart's roof below v ~1283
entities.note: Canopy u 12969-13109, v 1197-1249 (west tip ~(12969, 1230), rounded east end ~(13109, 1220)); post u 13042-13057 from v 1249 to 1283 where the second cart's roof hides it; foot est at the road's level v ~1300. The restyle paints a thatched canopy on a bracketed post. Main point u 13049 is on the t1/t2 boundary: t2 may record it too (drop one). MERGE: t2 recorded the same canopy as S4b.prop.thatched_canopy_13052 (retired as a duplicate; its base (13052, 1278) was 22 px from this one). t2 read it as a large round canopy of palm thatch like a big umbrella, u 12900-13109 (v 1203-1250, centre ~(13005, 1225)), on a short boxy post with lattice sides under its east part (u 13043-13060, v 1247-1278); its other reading, a pole hidden under the centre at u ~13005, also makes it this unit's.

entities.vis: part: west poles (if any) hidden by the cart's east end
entities.src: 余辉: 豪车云集 (the sedan beside the palm-covered carts)
entities.note: Roof u 13046-13144, v 954-978 (eave tip curls up at the west end ~(13050, 970)); body u 13060-13140, v 978-1138; lattice window u 13100-13140, v 986-1042; narrow west end strip u 13060-13080; corner legs at (13080, 1138) and (13138, 1138), standing on the ground (no one lifts it), so front and rear are the body's ends at the legs' foot line, not the poles' ends (their east ends are unclear: horizontal lines run east from the box at v ~1023-1050 to about u 13200-13260, mixed with the shop tables there). DEPTH DIRECTION: none (the west end strip's bottom runs level). Owned by t1 by the brief, though its main point is past 13050.

entities.what: Two customers sit at a long table in the open shop under the long roof, just behind the first cart's front.

entities.name: the open shop at the bottom of the silk
entities.what: An open-fronted shop at the bottom edge, under a long lattice eave: tables (one with a tray), a long bench, a dark jug, a slatted rack and a frame at the back, a tall barrel at the front; a faint figure sits at the tray table and a man in a light jacket stands at the front by the barrel.
entities.note: S4.fig.child_at_table_12597 (part 1's) reaches onto S4b.prop.table_12645. The shop front west of u 12700 is S4.bld.south_hall_12350's open front (part 1); east of 12700 is structures_w's next roof.

entities.name: the sedan chair set down, with its attendant
entities.what: A dark-roofed sedan chair stands set down on the road just east of the first palm-covered cart, its poles running east; a young man in a long light robe stands between the poles at its east side, its bearer or attendant waiting. No passenger shows.
entities.src: 余辉: 豪车云集 (the sedan beside the palm-covered carts)
entities.note: Made in the merge: t1 recorded the sedan (the brief gave it to t1), t2 the man between its poles (foot (13160, 1120)), and both asked for one group. It stands beside S4b.grp.palm_cart_13070 (the first cart) but is not part of it.

entities.name: slatted crate at the bottom shop's front, behind the small horse
entities.what: A box of horizontal slats (a crate or cage) standing at the open front of the bottom shop just east of its post, behind the head of the man in the light jacket and above the small horse's rump; its lower part is hidden by the horse.
entities.vis: part: below v ~1645 hidden behind S4b.ani.horse_12862's back
entities.note: SECOND PASS (west): no entity covers it, and no note names it. Strokes: slatted box u 12800-12838, v 1597-1645: two side posts, a darker top rail and about four horizontal slats; its lower edge meets the horse's back line (v ~1645-1652). It is not S4b.prop.slatted_rack_12732 (boards u 12700-12765, v 1540-1600, west of the shop's post at u 12768-12780; the man's head lies between the two). The restyle paints a slatted crate of round loaves here. Base est on the shop's open front line (its columns' feet est ~1700, S4b.road.main edge_s), about 45 px below the last visible slat. OTHER READING: a crate packed on the horse's rump (its bottom sits on the back line): support 'animal S4b.ani.horse_12862', base at the horse's hind (12862, 1765). The horse shows no pack frame or girth at that end (its dark band is at u 12913-12960), so the shop reading is chosen. The lead adds it to S4b.grp.bottom_shop_12750's members. SCALE CUE: 38 px wide, 48 px visible. Crops: S4b_second_west/z2_crate.jpg (zoom 4, scan | restyle), z2_bshop.jpg (zoom 2.2, scan | overlay), z2_cartrear_r.jpg.

entities.name: funnel-shaped vessel at the official hall's front railing
entities.what: A deep vessel, wide at its rim and narrowing to a small bottom (a wash basin on a stand, a hopper, or a deep sieve), at the front of the official hall's east bays between the man seated in the light robe and the man in the cap standing to the east; the seated man's right arm reaches toward it.
entities.vis: part: below its narrow bottom hidden behind the hall's front railing (v 916-935) or the first cart's roof
entities.note: SECOND PASS (west): no entity covers it. It is named only as 'the table' in S4b.fig.man_standing_by_hall_12942's what ('his arms lowered in front of him toward the table or the seated man'), so README rule 6 applies. Strokes: a straight rim (12865, 881) -> (12897, 881) with dark inner shading; its sides converge to a narrow bottom at about (12880-12888, 915-920). A frame of thin posts and two rails stands just east of it at u 12895-12932, v 907-952, either the railing's east bay where the raised floor ends (u ~12930) or the vessel's stand. The seated man's arm runs from his shoulder (12855, 920) toward the vessel's foot. The restyle paints a funnel-shaped tray with a dark lining on a stand, with the seated man's hand in it. SUPPORT: READING 1 (chosen): the vessel stands on the raised floor (H 0.45) just behind the front railing, whose top rail (v 916) meets its narrow bottom. Its foot is hidden, so the base is est at the floor's front. READING 2: it stands on a tall stand of its own on the ground beside the seated man (S4b.fig.man_seated_front_of_hall_12866, foot est v ~990): base est (12884, 990), support 'ground', a stand about as tall as the seated man. If accepted, the lead may add to S4b.fig.man_seated_front_of_hall_12866's what that his right arm reaches toward it. Crops: S4b_second_west/z2_trough.jpg (zoom 4, scan | restyle), z2_trough_p.jpg (zoom 4, no grid), z2_lintel.jpg (zoom 3.5, no grid | restyle).
